# NHS Inform Social Anxiety Self-help Guide

NHS Inform provides a social anxiety self-help guide based on CBT ideas. It covers patterns such as self-focused attention, anxious predictions, and avoidance, and offers structured self-help exercises that people can work through at their own pace.

For this project, the guide is a trustworthy public resource users can consult when they want a longer self-help explanation than the app itself should provide.
